note: MSSD says aid was given on 6 January 2026 to 3 Kapai families whose houses a fire totally destroyed; it gives no fire date and does not tie the 7 partially damaged houses to the fire.
summary: A fire in Kapai, Lanao del Sur totally destroyed the houses of 3 families, each granted P40,000 in Emergency Shelter Assistance by MSSD-BARMM on 6 January 2026. The fire's date, barangay, cause and casualties were not stated.
